meta.name: Teacup
meta.description: A mysterious event traps people on a rural Georgia farm, forcing them to unite against an unknown, deadly force. A young boy named Arlo becomes central to uncovering the truth.

videos.title: Think About the Bubbles
videos.overview: The animals act strangely at the Chenoweths' farm; the family and neighbors search for missing Arlo.

videos.title: My Little Lighthouse
videos.overview: With no cell service or electricity, the Chenoweths and their neighbors desperately seek help.

videos.title: Quite for No Reason
videos.overview: Ruben and James seek help from the Navarros; Arlo reveals the truth about what's going on.

videos.title: In the Heart of the Country
videos.overview: James and Ruben are held captive at the farm; Arlo, Meryl and Nicholas meet a mysterious man.

videos.title: I'm a Witness to the Sickness
videos.overview: Travis recounts how he took refuge at the Navarro farm, revealing the danger to James' family.

videos.title: You Don't Know What It Means to Win
videos.overview: James and Ruben return with a wounded McNab; James realizes a chilling truth about his mother.
